notes.title: Small Patch V1.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I am back with another small update to Input Out! As promised in a previous update, I have brought in some more achievements! Hope you're having fun trying to obtain them!

To sum up this patch, 12 more achievements have been added into the game. Including two hidden ones! I hope you'll have a fun time looking for these two. 

One other feature I've implemented with this patch is a level preview on the level select screen. So now you don't have to try to remember what level number you were last playing! This system may be tweeked a bit more in the near future. 

Thank you for reading my little update here. Take care and stay safe everyone!

- Shifu

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.notes:
Hello again!

Hope you're all doing well!

The small patch today was to address a bug that was introduced with the newly added achievements in the last patch. Silly me, forgot to change the name of a couple achievements in the code so they weren't triggering. *SIGH* This time I think I typed properly. We shall see. 

Also, did some slight balancing on some levels that seemed a little unfair in their timing windows. Hopefully it's not too easy for you well timed machines out there! 

As a final note, only two achievements were added today. One of them being for you completionists out there. I wish you the very best of luck in attempting to get this one. 300 stars is no easy feat. Might want to get a stress ball if you're going to attempt it. 

Until next time, take care and have fun!

- Shifu
